CONTEXT. The previous page gives Gauss's lemniscatic function P (the numerator in sl = P/Q):
P(z) = z - 2 z^5/5! - 36 z^9/9! + 552 z^13/13! + 5136 z^17/17! ...
The next page (cf. Werke III, around p. 408) writes
log p = log x - x^4/60 - x^8/4200 - x^12/321750 - x^16/19890000 - x^20/1180968750 = log x - phi.
This page links those two expansions. With t = x^4,
log(P/x) = -sum_k c_k t^k/k.
The top row lists c_1..c_5:
- c_1 = 1/(4.3.5) = 1/60
- c_2 = 1/(4.3.25.7) = 1/2100
- c_3 = 1/(2.3.125.11.13) = 1/107250
- c_4 = 1/(4.9.625.13.17) = 1/4972500
- c_5 = 1/(2.9.3125.13.17.19) = 1/236193750
Dividing c_k by k gives exactly the next page's denominators: 60, 4200, 321750, 19890000, 1180968750.

In modern terms P is the Weierstrass sigma function of the square (lemniscatic) lattice with g2 = 4, g3 = 0. Since log(sigma/z) = -sum G_{4k} z^{4k}/(4k), we have c_k = G_{4k}/4, where G_{4k} are the Eisenstein lattice sums. As a check, G_4 = g2/60 = 1/15 = 4 c_1.

LINE 2. The goal is P/x = exp(-sum c_k t^k/k) = sum a_k t^k. Gauss uses the Newton-type recursion (mine, implicit on the page)
k a_k = -sum_{j=1..k} c_j a_{k-j}, with a_0 = 1.
The resulting series is written at the top:
1 - t/60 - t^2/(32.9.5.7) + 23 t^3/(128.81.25.7.11.13) + 107 t^4/(2048.243.125.49.11.13.17) + 851 t^5/(8192.729.625.49.11.13.17.19).

THE WORKING BELOW.
- k=2: 2a_2 = 1/(16.9.25) - 1/(4.3.25.7) = (7-12)/(16.9.25.7) = -1/5040, so a_2 = -1/10080.
- k=3: 3a_3 = -1/(2.3.125.11.13) + 1/(16.9.125.7) + 1/(128.27.25.7).
  - The three terms are -c_3, -c_2 a_1 and -c_1 a_2.
  - Over the common denominator 128.27.125.7.11.13 the numerator is 715 + 3432 - 4032 = 115.
  - Hence a_3 = 23/(128.81.25.7.11.13). The previous page records 115 and 2^7 3^4 5^2 7.11.13.
- k=4: 4a_4 = -1/(4.9.625.13.17) + 1/(8.9.625.11.13) + 1/(128.27.125.49) - 23/(512.243.125.7.11.13).
  - The first two terms combine as (-22+17)/(8.9.625.11.13.17) = -1/(8.9.125.11.13.17).
  - Over the denominator 512.243.125.49.11.13.17 the cofactors are 64.27.49 = 84672, 4.9.11.13.17 = 87516 (side work 221, 884, 87516) and 23.7.17 = 2737 (side work 119, 238, 357, 2737).
  - Numerator: -84672 + 87516 - 2737 = 107, so a_4 = 107/(2048.243.125.49.11.13.17).
- k=5: the five terms are -c_5, -c_4 a_1, -c_3 a_2, -c_2 a_3 and -c_1 a_4.
  - The first two combine via (-24+19), giving -1/(16.27.625.13.17.19).
  - The remaining terms are +1/(64.27.625.7.11.13), -23/(512.243.625.49.11.13) and -107/(8192.729.625.49.11.13.17).
  - The common denominator is 8192.729.625.49.11.13.17.19. The cofactors are 7451136, 7814016 (= 3456.7.17.19; side work 7752000 + 62016), 356592 (= 48.23.17.19; side work 323, 15504, 31008, 46512) and 107.19.
